text: Carpenters are skilled artisans who make homes, buildings, and other structures. They work with materials like wood, stone, and metal to create functional and beautiful spaces. One important skill they must master is the art of carpentry. They start by planning the layout and measuring out materials, then cutting, shaping, and finishing each piece of wood to perfection. This includes joints, such as screws and nails, and varnish to protect the wood from stains and weather. Once the carpenter has created the desired look and feel for their work, they often use various techniques to make it look more polished and durable.
